## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION — Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive (Internal Rotation). Leadership: Broad (Top 5 span 5 sectors); confirmation: 1) sector breadth >50% with Utilities/Comm/Healthcare leading, 2) Technology and Financials underperforming while defensives and cyclicals show pockets of strength.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; Communication lead: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare leadership: LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology weak: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND; Financials weak: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY; INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY; NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND; MET (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -4.82%) BELOW TREND; PNC (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND; USB (1W: -6.82% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Financials).

6. Momentum Stocks?
Big 1W momentum: NFLX (1W: +22.33%), CEG (1W: +11.88%), PYPL (1W: +10.95%), INTU (1W: +7.48%), NEM (1W: +6.44%); note major divergence: several large names (PYPL, INTU, CRM) are RECOVERY (1W up / 1M down) — tactical bounces not confirmed as sustained trend changes.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is mixed-to-weak with sector 1W: -0.64% and 1M: -8.94%; NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY — expect rotation away from large-cap tech leaders until 1M performance confirms upside.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are lagging (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) with broad weakness: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND — downside concentrated and it's suppressing growth leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing defensive support: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND — sector breadth positive and confirming rotation into defensive/quality names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Utilities, Healthcare, Energy and select Materials where ABOVE TREND names exist (CEG, PFE, XOM, FCX); reduce exposure to large Financial names and core Tech while many remain BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective amid RECOVERY bounces.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (positive breadth), Communication (positive momentum), Energy (positive 1M) — Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. BEARISH: Financials, Technology, Consumer Discretionary remain at risk if 1W weakness extends.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch trend confirmation triggers rather than arbitrary prices: NVDA — sustained weekly closes below recent 1W lows would confirm continued BELOW TREND pressure; AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION — a weekly rebound turning positive would signal re-entry; WFC/AXP — continued weekly weakness would signal deeper Financial stress.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMZN (+65): AMZN (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND — bullish OpenAI deal headline but price still BELOW TREND (divergence). PFE (+65): PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND — news confirms price strength. LLY (+60): LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price in agreement.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
WFC (-60): WFC (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirming distribution. INTU (-50): INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY — bearish note but 1W bounce creates divergence, watch for follow-through. PYPL (-50): PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY — lawsuits/CEO change headlines conflict with strong short-term bounce; tactical risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, style mixed / no clear leadership. NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND and CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large names (PYPL, INTU, CRM RECOVERY vs. NVDA/MSFT/JPM BELOW TREND) and bullish headlines for AMZN while price remains BELOW TREND — watch for confirmation.
